pulls.title: Make six-month history the centerpiece of Sandemon's Lab
pulls.body:
## Summary
- Remove the portrait and make the six-month contribution archive the largest element in Sandemon's Lab.
- Backfill every day in the rolling six-month window via GitHub GraphQL and scroll the line continuously; keep the reactor, beakers, window, and status displays animated.
- Fix skyline windows, replace technical status copy with playful lab language, and use LadderStar's published Open Graph preview and current description.
- Default to public contributions; allow a read-only LAB_HISTORY_TOKEN secret if private contribution counts should appear in the public SVG.

## Verification
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- Browser rendered the generated SVG at README width.
- GitHub Actions update workflow succeeded twice on this branch; its own token generated the public six-month SVG.

pulls.title: Build Sandemon's animated pixel lab profile
pulls.body:
## Summary
- Replace the GIF header with a looping, activity-driven pixel lab featuring a scientist based on the green-suit portrait.
- Keep only LadderStar in Featured work, with a linked SVG feature card; remove the requested sections and update the title.
- Add a standard-library generator, config, scheduled/manual GitHub Actions update, and state tests.

## Verification
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- `python scripts/update_lab.py` against live public GitHub activity
- Parsed both SVGs as XML and inspected browser renders at README width.
